attchmntText: Lancor Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lancor Holdings Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the standalone and consolidated results on 14th November, 2026. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of 2,140.42 lakhs and a net profit of 1,790.92 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 2.43 rupees. Revenue from operations was 7,887.06 lakhs. Total assets as at 30th September, 2026, amounted to 43,989.43 lakhs. The statutory auditors, G. M. Kapadia & Co., issued a review report stating no material misstatements were found. The report notes the amalgamation of a wholly owned subsidiary with the company.
